name: Product variant picker
steps: Open a compatible section or parent block in the theme editor, select Add block, and choose Product variant picker. The parent controls its available space and overall layout.
Configure the block’s content first, then its presentation. Drag the block in its parent to change its position.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.label: Picker style
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for picker style. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Show selected value
settings.how: Turn on “Show selected value” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.
